title: SABD - Q2 Aeroporti con ritardi in partenza significativi (real-time)

panels.title: Voli con ritardo grave (>30 min) nel tempo - finestra 1h (per aeroporto in top-10)

targets.query: from(bucket: "flights") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "q2_1h" and r["_field"] == "severe_delays") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "origin_airport_id"]) |> group(columns: ["origin_airport_id"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Ritardo medio in partenza - finestra 1h (per aeroporto in top-10)

targets.query: from(bucket: "flights") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "q2_1h" and r["_field"] == "dep_delay_mean") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "origin_airport_id"]) |> group(columns: ["origin_airport_id"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Voli con ritardo grave (>30 min) nel tempo - finestra 6h (per aeroporto in top-10)

targets.query: from(bucket: "flights") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "q2_6h" and r["_field"] == "severe_delays") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "origin_airport_id"]) |> group(columns: ["origin_airport_id"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Top-10 aeroporti per ritardi gravi - finestra 1h (ultima finestra)

targets.query: from(bucket: "flights") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "q2_1h") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "num_flights" or r["_field"] == "severe_delays" or r["_field"] == "dep_delay_mean" or r["_field"] == "dep_delay_max" or r["_field"] == "delayed_flights") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "airport_rank", "origin_airport_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 10) |> sort(columns: ["airport_rank"])

panels.title: Top-10 aeroporti per ritardi gravi - finestra 6h (ultima finestra)

targets.query: from(bucket: "flights") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "q2_6h") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "num_flights" or r["_field"] == "severe_delays" or r["_field"] == "dep_delay_mean" or r["_field"] == "dep_delay_max" or r["_field"] == "delayed_flights") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "airport_rank", "origin_airport_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 10) |> sort(columns: ["airport_rank"])

panels.title: Top-10 aeroporti dall'inizio del dataset - global (finale)

targets.query: from(bucket: "flights") |> range(start: 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2201-01-01T00:00:00Z) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "q2_global") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "num_flights" or r["_field"] == "severe_delays" or r["_field"] == "dep_delay_mean" or r["_field"] == "dep_delay_max" or r["_field"] == "delayed_flights") |> group(columns: ["airport_rank", "origin_airport_id", "_field"]) |> last() |> keep(columns: ["airport_rank", "origin_airport_id", "_field", "_value"]) |> group() |> pivot(rowKey: ["airport_rank", "origin_airport_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with airport_rank: int(v: r.airport_rank), origin_airport_id: int(v: r.origin_airport_id) })) |> sort(columns: ["airport_rank"])

panels.title: Top-10 aeroporti dall'inizio del dataset - cumulative live

targets.query: from(bucket: "flights") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "q2_cumulative") |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.origin_airport_id) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "origin_airport_id" or r["_field"] == "num_flights" or r["_field"] == "severe_delays" or r["_field"] == "dep_delay_mean" or r["_field"] == "dep_delay_max" or r["_field"] == "delayed_flights") |> group(columns: ["airport_rank", "_field"]) |> last() |> keep(columns: ["airport_rank", "_field", "_value"]) |> group() |> pivot(rowKey: ["airport_rank"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with airport_rank: int(v: r.airport_rank), origin_airport_id: int(v: r.origin_airport_id) })) |> sort(columns: ["airport_rank"])
